subject: general
question: What is the total number of houses that make up the Indian Parliament?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Two**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Parliament of India** is the supreme legislative body of the **Republic of India**. It is **bicameral** in nature, meaning it consists of **two houses**: the **Rajya Sabha** and the **Lok Sabha**.
 
• According to **Article 79** of the **Constitution of India**, the Parliament for the Union consists of the **President** and the **two Houses**. While the **President** is an integral part of the Parliament, they are not a member of either house.
 
• The **Rajya Sabha**, also known as the **Council of States**, is the **Upper House** of the Parliament. It represents the **States** and **Union Territories** of India. It is a **permanent body** and is not subject to dissolution.
 
• The **Lok Sabha**, also known as the **House of the People**, is the **Lower House** of the Parliament. It represents the people of India as a whole, and its members are directly elected by the citizens through **universal adult suffrage**.
 
• The option **One** is incorrect because India does not follow a **unicameral** system at the federal level. The option **Three** is often a point of confusion because the Parliament has **three parts** (President, Lok Sabha, and Rajya Sabha), but it only has **two houses**. The option **Four** is incorrect as there are no other legislative chambers in the Indian federal structure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Rajya Sabha (Council of States):**

 
 
• The maximum strength of the **Rajya Sabha** is fixed at **250** members.
 
• Out of these, **238** members are elected by the **State Legislative Assemblies**, and **12** members are nominated by the **President** for their expertise in **Literature, Science, Art, and Social Service**.
 
• The **Vice-President of India** serves as the **Ex-officio Chairman** of the **Rajya Sabha**.
 
• Members are elected for a term of **six years**, with **one-third** of the members retiring every **two years**.
 
 
 
• **Lok Sabha (House of the People):**
 
 
• The maximum strength of the **Lok Sabha** as per the Constitution is **550** (after the **104th Constitutional Amendment Act, 2019**, which discontinued the nomination of **two Anglo-Indians**).
 
• The **Lok Sabha** has a normal term of **five years** from the date of its first meeting, after which it stands automatically dissolved.
 
• The **Speaker**, elected by the members of the **Lok Sabha**, is the presiding officer of the house.
 
 
 
• **Legislative Process:**
 
 
• A **Bill** must be passed by both the **Lok Sabha** and the **Rajya Sabha** to become an **Act**.
 
• In case of a deadlock between the two houses on an ordinary bill, the **President** can summon a **Joint Sitting** under **Article 108**.
 
• **Money Bills**, defined under **Article 110**, can only be introduced in the **Lok Sabha**, and the **Rajya Sabha** has limited powers regarding them.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The **New Parliament House** was inaugurated by **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** on **28 May 2023** as part of the **Central Vista Redevelopment Project** in **New Delhi**.
 
• The **New Parliament** building has a seating capacity of **888** members in the **Lok Sabha** and **384** members in the **Rajya Sabha**.
 
• The **Sengol**, a historical sceptre from **Tamil Nadu**, was installed in the new **Lok Sabha** chamber near the **Speaker’s chair**.
 
• The first session in the new building was held in **September 2023** during a **Special Session of Parliament**, where the **Nari Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam** (Women's Reservation Bill) was introduced.
 
• The **Parliament** usually meets for three sessions in a year: the **Budget Session** (January/February to May), the **Monsoon Session** (July to September), and the **Winter Session** (November to December).
